conclusionTemplates.normal: Findings compatible with normal vaginal microbiota (Type I flora). Nugent score of {{score}}/10, within the normal range. Negative Amsel clinical criteria ({{count}} of 4). No signs suggestive of bacterial vaginosis.
conclusionTemplates.intermediate: Intermediate vaginal microbiota (Type II flora), Nugent score of {{score}}/10, without definitive criteria for a diagnosis of bacterial vaginosis ({{count}} of 4 Amsel criteria positive). Clinical correlation and re-evaluation, if needed, are recommended.
conclusionTemplates.bacterial_vaginosis: Findings compatible with bacterial vaginosis (Type III flora), confirmed by both the laboratory criterion — Nugent score of {{score}}/10 — and the clinical Amsel criterion ({{count}} of 4 criteria positive).
conclusionTemplates.discordant: Discordant findings between the laboratory and clinical criteria: Nugent score of {{score}}/10 ({{classification}}) and {{count}} of 4 Amsel criteria positive. Careful clinical correlation and, if needed, repeat testing are recommended.

_comment_findingsTemplates: Standard microscopic description texts per diagnosis. Review clinically before shipping to production.

findingsTemplates.normal: Smear showing predominance of lactobacilli (Döderlein bacilli), preserved epithelial morphology, and no significant increase in leukocytes. No clue cells, no relevant amount of gram-variable coccobacilli, no fungal elements or Trichomonas vaginalis. Flora compatible with normal vaginal microbiota (Type I flora).
findingsTemplates.intermediate: Smear showing mixed bacterial flora, with reduced numbers of lactobacilli and gram-variable coccobacilli present in intermediate quantity. No definitive criteria for bacterial vaginosis. Findings compatible with intermediate flora (Type II flora); clinical correlation is recommended.
findingsTemplates.bacterial_vaginosis: Vaginal flora predominantly composed of gram-variable coccobacilli, with scarce or absent lactobacilli and presence of clue cells, compatible with bacterial vaginosis (Type III flora).
findingsTemplates.discordant: Smear with microscopic findings that do not correlate consistently between the laboratory criterion (Nugent) and the clinical criterion (Amsel). Careful clinical correlation and, if needed, repeat testing are recommended.
